lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，鳍肢一撑一撑。
lines.en: I crawl close to the ground, fins pushing.

lines.zh: 湿滑的身子在地上留下水痕。
lines.en: My slick body leaves a wet trail.
I keep pace with your steps.

lines.zh: 我的触须在空气里试探。
lines.en: My tendrils probe the air.
I round a stone without a sound.

lines.zh: 我爬得不快，但一直跟着。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never stop following.

lines.zh: 身体两侧的鳃一张一合。
lines.en: The gills along my sides flare and close.
I'm near your heels.

lines.zh: 我闻到猎物的味道，加快了。
lines.en: I smell prey and speed up.
I part the grass with a forelimb.

lines.zh: 我的壳刮着地面，沙沙响。
lines.en: My carapace rasp on the ground.
I stop and flatten myself.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方留下水痕。
lines.en: A wet trail follows where I crawl.
I slip ahead and look back.
I test every step before taking it.

lines.zh: 我像一团活的影子在移动。
lines.en: I move like a living shadow.

lines.zh: 我伏在你身边，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie beside you, motionless.
My eyestalks turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的黏液在灯下发亮。
lines.en: My slime gleams under the light.
I'm listening.
My gills flutter.

lines.zh: 我缩在你脚边，鳃慢慢合上。
lines.en: I curl at your feet, gills closing slowly.
My tendrils retract joint by joint.
I don't need you to talk.
I wait for your word.
This life is yours now.
I lick my forelimb.
Something moves far off; I raise my head.
I press my head back down.
The sea has dried off me; it itches.
I raise my head and look at your face.
You're my master. I know.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，等你示意。
lines.en: I lower my head, waiting for a sign.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在看你，也在看你后面。
lines.en: I'm watching you, and past you.

lines.zh: 你手上的气味，我记住了。
lines.en: I've learned the smell of your hands.
I press against your leg.
You step back; I step back.
Your hand lifts and I tense.
I won't bite you.
My teeth point elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的鳍就撑一步。
lines.en: Each step you take, my fins push once.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很低的鸣叫。
lines.en: I make a low, wet sound.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，我就安心了。
lines.en: One glance from you settles me.
I won't stray far.
I shriek and curl up.
Blood mixes with my slime.
I retreat, gills pumping.
That tore my hide.
I flatten and give a low cry.
I stare at the wound without a sound.
I can still crawl.
I fall back behind you.
Pain makes me fiercer.

lines.zh: 血渗进鳃里，我闷哼一声。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my gills; I grunt.
That's meat. I smell it.

lines.zh: 血腥味顺着你的指缝滴下来。
lines.en: Blood smell drips between your fingers.
I sniff first, then eat.
I wait for your nod before I eat.
I bite it and drag it toward you.
I don't snatch food.
That's barely a mouthful.
I can wait.
Set it down and I'll eat.
After eating, I keep following.

lines.zh: 海水味和血味混在一起。
lines.en: Sea smell and blood smell mixed.
I look up and wait for your nod.
My tendrils wrap around it.
I eat slowly.
The knock slides me aside.
I turn back at once.
My slick body sheds the impact.
I brace against your leg.

lines.zh: 我立刻绷紧身子，护住你。
lines.en: I tense at once and shield you.

lines.zh: 我拿身子替你挡了一下。
lines.en: I take the knock for you with my flank.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我鳃全张开。
lines.en: That hit flares every gill wide.
You're not hurt, are you?
My gills flare wide.
Whoever touched you, I'll remember.

lines.zh: 这是海嗣的繁衍，不需要仪式。
lines.en: This is how my kind breeds. No ceremony.
I'll be gone a short while.
Something in the sea answers.
We leave the eggs in the shallows.
The tide will carry them.
I come back to your side.
I'm still wet.
I lower myself so you can see my back.
The new blood will be stronger.
That's the way of the seaborn.
I curl a tendril around it.
It sticks and won't shake off.
I put it in my mouth.
This thing is still alive.
I drag it to your feet.
I sniff. Edible.
So small I nearly missed it.
I crack the shell open.
Juice runs down my limb.
This one's for you.
I raise my head, gills wide.
There's the smell of blood.
I flatten, ready to spring.
That thing is moving.
I'll move first, to shield you.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的低鸣变了调。
lines.en: The growl in my throat changes pitch.
I lock onto its position.
It's weaker than you.
Don't come closer.
My low cry is a warning.
I keep after it.
It runs for the water. Better still.
I go around, hugging the ground.
My tendrils seek its legs.
It swings; I slip away.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，绕到它侧面。
lines.en: I drop low and circle to its flank.
It's bleeding.
No rush; blood will wear it down.
I circle it.
Its legs fail; I spring.

lines.zh: 我把整副身子的重量压上去。
lines.en: I throw my whole weight onto it.
Teeth clamp and tear.
My tendrils lash its leg.
A dirty blow, but it works.
I pin it and go for the throat.
I'm thrown off.
I lunge again at once.
My teeth tear its hind leg.
It breaks and bolts for the trees.
I lick the blood from my teeth.
I chose you, and followed you ashore.
Water still runs off me.
I look at you, and I'm yours.

lines.zh: 海嗣的规矩，认了就不改。
lines.en: Seaborn law: once chosen, never changed.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩爬上来，鳃还湿着。
lines.en: I crawl from the shallows, gills still wet.

lines.zh: 鳃第一次在空气里张开。
lines.en: My gills open in air for the first time.
The air makes my gills tighten.
But I'll endure it.
I crawl to your feet.
I raise my head and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我的黏液被烤干，皮在裂。
lines.en: My slime bakes dry and my hide cracks.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，软软地弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit the ground and bounce softly.

lines.zh: 水下我不怕，可我找不到上去的路。
lines.en: Water doesn't scare me, but I can't find the way up.
The blast flattens me.
An arrow passes through my fin.

lines.zh: 光锁住我的黏液，我动不了。
lines.en: Light sets my slime and I can't move.

lines.zh: 饿得我连触须都抬不起来。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift a tendril.
Lightning hits and my whole body spasms.

lines.zh: 我正在往下沉，水也没有。
lines.en: I'm sinking, and there's not even water.
